city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in Chandler: Arizona birth support and doula care with the San Tan Mountains in the background
city_fields.culture: Chandler is a fast-growing suburban city in the East Valley of the Phoenix metro area, with a population of roughly 285,000. Its birth culture reflects a mix of long-standing Arizona families and newer transplants, with a strong emphasis on hospital-based care and a growing doula community. The city benefits from proximity to both Chandler Regional Medical Center and a network of East Valley birth resources.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Yes — Arizona Medicaid (AHCCCS) covers doula services for eligible enrollees. Families should contact their managed care plan to confirm doula coverage and find in-network providers.
